Name: Power Unit
Description: This multi-fuel power generator supplies the Behemoth with a base amount of energy and directs all excess power to the engine.

Name: Sensor System
Description: This system collects and processes environmental data: identifying resources, points of interest, and mission opportunities. It also defines the control zone.

Name: Engine
UsesForServices: Fusion Cell, Bio Cell, Fuel Cell, Positron Cell
Description: The engine powers the Behemoth's movement using fuel cells, energy generators, and other power sources.

Name: Mass Driver
Description: A 360-degree mass driver that launches Extractor capsules.

Name: R&D Lab
Description: This specialized design facility converts fragmented Blueprints into building schematics.

Name: Resource Allocation Center
Description: A storage facility for stockpiling, preservation, and distribution of any collected or produced resources.

Name: Tools Workshop
Description: This workshop produces sheets of structural materials and stamps various tool kits used in their installation.

Name: Electronics Workshop
Description: This workshop specializes in producing fine electronic components and superconductors used in many other manufacturing chains.

Name: Repairs Workshop
Description: This workshop produces mending materials and repair tools necessary to deal with the most common breakages on this ship.

Name: Processing Workshop
Description: Equipped with a giant smelter, this workshop processes metals and forms them into modular prefabs.

Name: Synthesis Workshop
Description: This workshop specializes in the electrolysis of simple reagents and proteins, as well as the production of nanomaterials.

Name: Compounds Workshop
Description: This chemical processing workshop specializes in blending reagents, metals, and alloys in a highly controlled environment.
BuildingTags: Exploration, Fuel, Building, Evolution, Mining, Food

Name: Chemistry Workshop
Description: This workshop focuses on the development and synthesis of complex materials, including biochemical substances and myco-materials.

Name: Bioengineering Workshop
Description: This workshop specializes in biotechnical engineering, synthesizing complex proteins and construction materials.

Name: Farm
Description: This farm provides a controllable environment for the accelerated growth of grains. It is also equipped with a system of vats to synthesize cultured meat and biopolymers.

Name: Plantation
Description: Forget the usual connotation of the word 'plantation,' this place is primarily designed to grow cultured meat in rows of specialized synthesis vats. But it does have zones dedicated to Omni fruits and even thermoplastics.

Name: Universum
Description: This facility is designed to fuel both the ship and its crew by containing the equipment to process local resources into ship fuel, as well as green zones to yield grains and Omni-fruits.
BuildingTags: Evolution, Fuel, Building, Exploration, Mining, Food

Name: Electronics Factory
Description: This factory is integral to our mission by manufacturing electronic components and sensors for our research equipment and vehicles.

Name: Pyrogenics Factory
Description: This highly safeguarded factory produces reactive and explosive components.

Name: Nano-Tech Factory
Description: This factory specializes in the production of fine components used in many complex tools and devices.

Name: Prototype Development Factory
Description: Specialized in fuel development and nanotechnology, this factory manufactures components for sensors, power cells, and other, more exotic materials.

Name: Container Factory
Description: This factory's main specialty is the production of storage equipment and mining devices.

Name: Expedition Research Factory
Description: This building crafts equipment useful in on-land missions and expeditions, as well as sample collection and resource extraction.

Name: Energy Research Factory
Description: This facility specializes in developing advanced energy storage solutions.

Name: Component Factory
Description: This building processes organic matter into consumer products. Cleaned-out storage units are returned to general use.

Name: Medical Goods Factory
Description: This factory produces medical and pharmaceutical supplements for the crew. The production waste is reused for energy purposes.

Name: Food Factory
Description: This factory specializes in synthesizing complex food items with an increased nutritional value and richer flavors.

Name: Advanced Tools Plant
ProducesHighEfficiency: Tricoder, Tech Voxel, Smart Ammunition Pack
Description: This plant fabricates sophisticated high-tech devices for various purposes.

Name: Expedition Plant
Description: This building specializes in equipment crucial for the success of field research crews.

Name: Smart Tools Plant
Description: This factory specializes in developing complex devices with integrated AI support.

Name: Tactical Production Plant
ProducesMidEfficiency: Med Kit, Multi-Tool, Portable Force Shield
Description: This facility is responsible for developing tactical gear and advanced extractors.

Name: Consumer Goods Plant
Description: With a focus on providing the crew with personal-use items, this plant produces a steady flow of medical and alimentary materials, as well as self-entertainment devices.

Name: Nasobi Building
Description: This building closely follows the Nasobi architectural tradition, catering to the needs of the Nasobi crew members.

Name: Aetherid Building
Description: This building closely follows the Aetherid architectural tradition, catering to the needs of the Aetherod crew members.

Name: Crabari Building
Description: This building closely follows the Crabari architectural tradition, catering to the needs of the Crabari crew members.

Name: Mistralid Building
Description: This building closely follows the Mistralid architectural tradition, catering to the needs of the Mistralid crew members.

Name: Knidaria Building
Description: This building closely follows the Knidaria architectural tradition, catering to the needs of the Knidaria crew members.

Name: Hi-Tech Facility
Description: A dual-purpose facility that produces surveying equipment, as well as production-optimizing mechanisms.

Name: Experimental Materials Facility
Description: This facility focuses on the research and development of advanced experimental technologies.

Name: Robotics Facility
Description: This facility is dedicated to AI training and fabrication of state-of-the-art prosthetics and advanced power cells.

Name: Advanced Wares Facility
Description: This facility is designed to manufacture a variety of advanced tech products.

Name: Satellite Control Complex
Description: This facility launches satellites and processes the data they transmit.

Name: Antimatter Core Unit
Description: This generator produces energy through the reaction of antimatter with other materials.

Name: Advanced Technology Center
Description: This facility enables the production of Positron Cells: the pinnacle of power cell design.

Name: Evolution Center
Description: This research center allows human crew members to transcend their biological limits.

Name: Artifacts Lab
Description: This specialized facility studies local cultural relics to gain Knowledge.

Name: Health and Care Center
Description: This facility is foundational to the crew's well-being. Outfitted with advanced medical equipment, it provides on-site healthcare services to the crew.

Name: Bioconversion Lab
Description: This building processes biological waste, reducing environmental damage and salvaging some of the resources in return.

Name: Geo Lab
UsesForServices: Manufacturing Waste, Alloyed Metal, Conductive Materials, Metal Constructions
Description: This building processes toxic waste, reducing environmental damage and salvaging some materials as by-products.

Name: Medical Center
Description: Fitted with state-of-the-art medical equipment, this facility helps recover from injuries and provides basic disease prevention measures.

Name: Social dome
Description: This facility provides the crew with a well-suited space for socializing and communal activities. In addition to being a recreational area, it is used for vaccine administration.

Name: Institute
UsesForServices: Manufacturing Waste, Alloyed Metal, Conductive Materials, Metal Constructions
Description: Specialized in advanced studies, an Institute not only provides disease control and prevention measures, but also trains specialists capable of drastically improving workplace productivity.

Name: Holodeck
Description: Furnished with the latest augmented reality equipment, Holodeck emulates realistic environments for entertainment and educational purposes.

Name: Alliance Center
Description: Designed to unite crew members from across the galaxy, this facility accommodates their every need, making everyone feel right at home, which is perfect for teambuilding initiatives.

Name: General quarters
Description: Compact and secure, this building provides a simple housing option for crew members.

Name: Residential Complex
Description: Comfortable yet ergonomic, this structure provides a comfortable living environment for each crew member.

Name: Solar Panels
Description: This structure converts sunlight into energy and feeds it directly into the Behemoth's systems. Non-reliant on other power sources, the provided energy depends exclusively on solar activity.

Name: Energy Accumulator
Description: A set of batteries that reserves large quantity of energy that can later be used during a deficit.

Name: Small Energy Accumulator
Description: A set of batteries that accumulates excess energy for later use when energy is in deficit.

Name: Generator
Description: This basic power generator uses fuel cells for thermoelectric conversion. While quite efficient, it leaves a tremendous carbon footprint.

Name: Cyclone Energy Turbine
Description: A small but effective wind turbine that provides a decent amount of energy even during weak wind activity. Its efficiency is increased dramatically by the storms.

Name: Solar Reactor
Description: A set of compound plates suspended in an inert gas captures and stores enough solar heat to conduct a complex chemical reaction that generates much energy.

Name: Fusion Core Unit
Description: This structure fuses atomic nuclei to produce energy, allowing an enormous output of power with minimal expense of resources.

Name: Hangar
ProducesHighEfficiency: Freighter, Recon Craft, Deep Sea Trawler, Worker Drone
Description: This place houses worker drones, freighters, and scout ships.

Name: Power Bolt Emitter
Description: This underwater weapon is designed to fight off large sea creatures.

Name: Gatling Gun
Description: This onboard weapon is used to fight off small flying creatures, as well as small ships and drones.

Name: Photon Gun
Description: This onboard weapon is powerful enough to defend against large sea, land, and flying creatures.

Name: Grenade Launcher
Description: This artillery weapon is used against hostile creatures on land.

Name: Active defense system
Description: This set of automatic turrets placed around the ship shoots down projectiles threatening the Behemoth.

Name: Flamethrower
Description: This onboard weapon uses chemical fuel to project jets of fire against the enemy.

Name: Power Barrier
Description: This expendable and rechargeable force field can absorb various types of damage, but it needs time to recharge.
